subject: Roper
picture: A roper stands in a cave like a thick stalagmite. Identity anatomy lock: rocky conical body growing from the floor, one wide toothy mouth on the upper body, one central eye, four large simple tendrils reaching out. Not an octopus and not a tree. Cave ceiling with a few stalactites, rock walls, large floor stones, closed tunnel. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02. All-ages, no gore.
